Updates:
HARD open-items close-if-ignored: if the owner ignores listed open items and keeps messaging for 5 minutes or more without picking them up, drop them from LIVE open-items without re-asking (same as skip/moved-on); shorter gaps stay open; reopen only if the owner brings them back.

HARD never delete an entire remote repository: never propose deleting a whole GitHub/remote repository. Clean junk branches, leftover PRs, and leftover files only. Anything the owner marked KEEP on the cut list must not be deleted.

HARD WAL priority: designated heavy-task chief seat — stuck-turn risk ≥2 MB (or extreme runaway); out of control ≥4 MB and still growing; other seats ≥512 KB; fleet scan quiet under the heavy seat’s 2 MB floor.

@elonmusk
